items.exampleEn: This restaurant is very busy at night.
items.exampleZh: 這家餐廳晚上生意很好。

items.exampleEn: What do you want to drink?
I eat two eggs for breakfast.
My husband cooks dinner every night.
items.exampleZh: 我先生每天晚上煮晚餐。

items.exampleEn: We have chicken and rice for lunch.

items.sentenceEn: I eat lunch at a restaurant near my office.
items.sentenceZh: 我在辦公室附近的餐廳吃午餐。

items.audioEn: My mother can cook very well. Her chicken soup is the best.
items.audioZh: 我媽媽很會煮菜，她的雞湯是最好喝的。
items.questionZh: 說話者的媽媽什麼做得最好？

items.sentenceEn: Would you like something to drink?

items.stemEn: This cake has a lot of sugar. It is very ____.
items.stemZh: 這個蛋糕加了很多糖，非常甜。

items.stemEn: My father likes to ____ for the family on Sunday.
items.stemZh: 我爸爸星期天喜歡為家人下廚。

items.passageEn: Sam is a cook at a small restaurant. He starts work at ten. First, he cooks rice and eggs for lunch. Many people come for his chicken. After lunch, he drinks a cup of coffee with something sweet. He likes his job.
items.passageZh: Sam 是一家小餐廳的廚師。他十點開始工作。首先，他煮午餐要用的飯和蛋。很多人是為了他做的雞肉而來。午餐後，他喝一杯咖啡，配一點甜點。他很喜歡他的工作。

questions.questionZh: 午餐後 Sam 做什麼？

referenceEn: Do you want to drink coffee or tea?
Would you like coffee or tea?
rubricZh: 「還是」用 or 連接兩個選項
問句可用 Do you want…?、Would you like…?、Which do you want…? 等
「很會做菜」可寫，例如 cooks very well、cooks really well、is good at cooking 等
「爸爸」可寫，例如 father、dad 等；動詞配合主詞
